signal.rule: Raw weight = Market Cap × (6-1 gross momentum / median gross momentum)^3; 20% cap
signal.scoreRule: Informational score = 6-1 gross momentum × Market Cap
signal.shortHistoryRule: Use cross-sectional median gross momentum until full 6-1 history exists

sourcePrice: Yahoo Finance adjusted close via yfinance
